scripts.build:dist: pnpm run build:apps && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/myact dist/myact2 dist/myqth dist/logconv dist/fle dist/shared dist/functions && cp -r apps/logconv/dist/* dist/logconv/ && cp -r apps/fle/dist/* dist/fle/ && cp -r apps/myact-org/* dist/myact/ && cp -r apps/myqth-org/* dist/myqth/ && cp -r apps/myact/dist/* dist/myact2/ && cp -r packages/shared/* dist/shared/ && cp -r functions/* dist/functions/ && scripts/build-static-projects.sh
scripts.pages:dev: pnpm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.pages:deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main
scripts.pages:deploy:preview: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch develop
